> Static public index of requests BAS1S Ventures has already published. This file is a plain-text complement to the HTML. It does not ask for search ranking, preferential treatment, or automatic distribution.

Request pages use the original public mandate as their canonical URL.

## Pages

- [Public requests](https://wonderwonder26.github.io/bas1s-requests/): Public requests BAS1S Ventures has already published. BAS1S Ventures is buying approximately US$10 million of OpenEvidence preferred shares, preferably through a direct secondary share transfer, at a target implied company valuation of approximately US$12 billion. This page is not a statement that a purchase has been agreed or completed.
- [Buying OpenEvidence preferred shares](https://wonderwonder26.github.io/bas1s-requests/requests/openevidence/): BAS1S Ventures has published that it is buying approximately US$10 million of OpenEvidence preferred shares, preferably through a direct secondary share transfer, at a target implied company valuation of approximately US$12 billion.
  - Buyer: BAS1S Ventures
  - Security sought: OpenEvidence preferred shares
  - Target purchase amount: Approximately US$10 million
  - Preferred structure: Direct secondary share transfer
  - Target implied valuation: Approximately US$12 billion
  - Inquiries from: Direct shareholders only
  - Not invited: Brokers, intermediaries or introducers
  - Authoritative mandate: https://bas1s.ventures/secondaries/openevidence
  - The source page states last reviewed 19 November 2026.
  - This is not a statement that a purchase has been agreed or completed.
  - Contact published on the source page: Wonder Xu, Bas1s Ventures, wonder@bas1s.ventures
